description:
Sets one Client's Chase for a Quarter to ready, partial, nothing_to_report, skipped or back to waiting, with an optional note; Nudges stop for ready/nothing_to_report/skipped and resume for waiting/partial. The change is recorded in the Client's history.
Use this when: records arrived another way (office, post, email) or a Client should be skipped this Quarter.

client.description: Client name, email or your own reference

idempotency_key.description: Optional; reuse when retrying so the change happens once.

quarter.description: Quarter like "2026-27 Q3". Default: the Quarter whose HMRC deadline is next.

name: mark_chase
title: Set a Chase status
